items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: then he played with Harry James for about fifteen years

ctx.x: Johnny was gone, so what could he say?

No, but he was back now. He was back. He came back into Duke’s band. He went away for about six or seven years, yeah and then he went back. He went back, see and there he’s got Willie Smith. See, the whole Lunceford band really played for Willie Smith. Willie Smith was Avant Garde. Willie played – he could play higher on the saxophone that any alto saxophone player could play at that time. Now they play all up that, but that was commonplace with Willie. And Willie would never miss anything. He never – and Duke…
‘Cause he would pass it? ‘Cause he looked – he was very light skinned.
